title: Horse
description: Canonical horse identity record. Anchored by microchip number — the durable, immutable identifier for every NZ thoroughbred.

microchip.description: NZ microchip number (15 digits). The durable anchor. Never changes. Sourced from loveracing.nz Stud Book.

lifeNumber.description: NZTR life number. Sourced from loveracing.nz Stud Book.

loveracingId.description: HorseID on loveracing.nz. Used to construct the profile URL: /Breeding/{loveracingId}/{slug}.aspx

name.description: Registered horse name including country suffix and year. e.g. 'Prudentia (NZ) 2021'

nameSlug.description: URL-safe slug of the horse name. e.g. 'Prudentia-NZ-2021'

foalingDate.description: Date of birth. Sourced from loveracing.nz.

age.description: Current age in years. Computed from foalingDate.

sireId.description: Reference to the sire (father) horse document ID. null if unknown.

damId.description: Reference to the dam (mother) horse document ID. null if unknown.

damName.description: Dam name for display. e.g. 'LITTLE BIT IRISH (NZ) 2012'

dnaTyped.description: Whether the horse has been DNA typed.

pv.description: Whether the horse has been parentage verified.

leftShoulderBrand.description: Left shoulder brand description. e.g. 'KB INSIDE CIRCLE'

rightShoulderBrand.description: Right shoulder brand description. e.g. '85 OVER 1'

trainerId.description: Reference to the current trainer document ID.

trainer.description: Current trainer name (from loveracing.nz breeding page).

imageUrl.description: Primary image GCS URL. null if no image uploaded yet.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.
